story.value: American scientists Albert Ghiorso, Torbjørn Sikkeland, Almon E. Larsh and Robert M. Latimer created lawrencium in March 1961.
Lawrencium is named after Lawrence, the inventor of the cyclotron.
The scientists who made lawrencium were working at the Lawrence Radiation Laboratory in Berkeley, California.
